invariants.rationale: Returned Option object should not be null to signify a valid Option result.
The index instant time parameter should be a non-empty string, as it is used to identify an instant for indexing.
The engine context is required for index operation execution and should not be null at method exit.
Result's presence state is always determinable via Option contract (trivially true for all Option values).
The method is always expected to return an Option result by contract.
